TPUv2 is more efficient than GPU for training phase, while GPU is more efficient than TPUv2 for prediction phase.

the speedup for training stage is up to 10 times, for prediction stage is up to twice, the speedup depends on the utilization level (the number of cores used) and the batch size, and that the speedup is obtained without any loss of accuracy.

the influence of batch size on the performance of GPU and TPU during training and inference stages.
the influence of the maximally allowed batch size on performance of graphic and tensor processing units during training and inference stages.

the impact of the maximization of batch size on performance of GPUs and TPUs during training and inference stages, and it is demonstrated that TPUv2 can be a good alternative for GPU usage in case of low-scale usage of TPUs and large batch sizes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TPUv2 unit is a very efficient and promising device for training and prediction of DNNs.

the use of Google TPU v2 units in the training and inference phases of deep neural network is a promising solution that can significantly speed-up the training and inference of the deep neural network.
for the training stage TPUv2 provides a speedup of 10x for the batch size > 512 and for the prediction stage TPUv 2 provides a speed of 2x (with and without overhead) for the batch size> 40,000.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TPUv2 unit is more efficient for the large-scale data processing than the GPU card for training and inference phases.
the TPUv2 is a promising alternative to the GPU for the low-to-mid-scale DNN training and prediction.
the usage of TPUv3 units is highly recommended for the training of deep learning models, while the inference stage can be performed either on TPU or GPU depending on the available resources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the usage of TPUs can significantly accelerate the deep learning process and can be recommended for training and inference stages of deep learning applications.
TPUv2 is a promising hardware for DNN training and inference for large datasets and large batch sizes.
for the datasets with images of sizes >28x28, and especially for the datasets with videos, the speedup of TPU over GPU will be even higher.
